subject: fix(gate): exempt curl to localhost daemon — edge sig >> false-positives as shell redirect
description: orch-gate-bash.sh's write-pattern detector flags `>>` anywhere in a command. Edge signatures use `>>` as a separator (e.g. `task/22>>task/5`). When a judge drain agent POSTs `curl -d '{"sig":"a>>b",...}' localhost:8787/judge/verdict`, the gate extracts the text after `>>` as a write target and then runs a worktree branch check, blocking the HTTP call. Fix: add a curl-to-localhost exemption right after the git VCS exemption block in orch-gate-bash.sh. Should exit 0 before write-pattern detection for any curl command targeting localhost on port $PORT (8787).
